evidence_boundary: R01 is a versioned minimal root-cause contract, not a rerun or amendment of R02. Static checking may bind immutable R02 evidence, the original candidate token, the ngspice no-compatibility log, official documentation URLs, local Xyce 7.10 source hashes, exact minimal probes, analytic expectations, two-process budget, failure retention and no-downstream rules. A future runner may invoke ngspice and Xyce once each on three expression points, one known branch-current sentinel and three original/portable candidate points. Even a complete root-cause chain can establish only the numerical expression-semantics cause and a bounded portable-expression remedy at those probes. It cannot establish physical IGZO parameters, experimental calibration, full 247-row route agreement, formal M01 closure, circuit readiness, layout, PEX or HZO evidence.
next_gate: Commit and push this static result before the one permitted two-process minimal root-cause probe.
